alt: 寒冷天氣裡，鄰居把保暖毯和一壺熱飲送給沒有暖氣、正在發抖的一家人。
scene_prompt: 雪中送炭 means giving timely help when someone urgently needs it. Modern modest home during a cold winter power outage. Inside, a parent and child huddle on a sofa in coats, visibly shivering; the room's simple lamp is dark and snowy weather is visible through the window. At the open doorway a kind neighbor has JUST ARRIVED and offers a thick warm blanket and a steaming thermos cup to the grateful family. Focus on the handoff of warmth to people who need it, not lavish gifts or a celebration. Pale snow outside, gentle warm brown doorway and soft blue-green clothing, emotional relief. No text, no coal fire, no electrical danger.
